meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为作品添加品牌色彩与排版风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容快速应用品牌视觉规范。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your artifacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual guidelines to your content.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为生成的文档、演示文稿等应用 Anthropic 官方品牌色和字体，包括标题用 Poppins 字体、正文用 Lora 字体，并自动选择颜色。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 创建或格式化需要体现 Anthropic 品牌风格的内容时触发，例如制作公司演示文稿或品牌文档。

say.text: 帮我做一个 Anthropic 品牌风格的演示文稿。
say.note: Claude 会应用品牌色和字体生成幻灯片。

say.text: 用 Anthropic 的配色和字体格式化这份文档。
say.note: Claude 会调整文档颜色和字体。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to generated artifacts, using Poppins for headings and Lora for body text, with automatic color selection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create or format content that should reflect Anthropic's brand style, such as company presentations or brand documents.

say_en.text: Create a presentation with Anthropic brand styling.
say_en.note: Claude will apply brand colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Format this document using Anthropic's colors and fonts.
say_en.note: Claude will adjust colors and typography.
